I have 0.17 hectares of maize that I intercrop, and my whole farm is only 0.68 hectares, so I must be careful with every kwacha I spend. Through the government subsidy program I can get some chemical fertilizer and hybrid seed, which I will use because the hybrid maize gives better food for my family. But I cannot afford pesticides or hired labor, and we have no irrigation here in Balaka, so I will depend on the rains and do the weeding with my own hands and my family's help.
